from typing import List
from collections import Counter
class Solution:
    def numberOfPairs(self, nums: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        c = Counter(nums)
        pairs = sum(v // 2 for v in c.values())
        leftover = sum(v % 2 for v in c.values())
        return [pairs, leftover]
